timing: uninstrumented TT and no null observers; normal public diagnostics on; whole driver request only; allocation before timed request excluded
inference: per-root paired/geometric means, distributions and CPU; no strength inference or timing claims from instrumented data
limitations: node counts not equal work across different guard formulations
construction/reset allocation excluded and measured separately
stop: 60s request or 15min domain, fail on accounting/PV/drain/board integrity; preserve failures
selection: prefer a useful consumer with manageable costs; do not automatically retain bound guard because it is implemented
